description: Installation of a Computer Network for the Department of Examinations, Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-06-22 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Department of Examinations, Sri Lanka conducts over 300 examinations annually, including national level examinations, and a computerized management information system is used to manage all the data and critical tasks associated with the operations of those examinations. Since the main operational functions of the department exist as computer networks that are unique to each division, many critical stages of the examination process have to be handled using human resources only, and data and documents are transferred between branches through physical channels. As a result, it has been observed that there is a decrease in efficiency, delays, wastage of physical and human resources, etc. Therefore, it has been identified that it is essential to upgrade the computer network infrastructure of the Department of Examinations in line with the current digitalization process of public sector services. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister, in her capacity as the Minister of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education, to design, install and operate a wide computer network covering all branches of the Department of Examinations Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.
